Name: Activated Sprinklers
Author: StultusVMods
Description:
This mod allows you to right click on a sprinkler and activate it. It's used for when you switch to a new season, mainly after winter, and you need to water the crops after you've planted your new crops. Since sprinklers normally only activate once in the morning, you'd have to water all the crops on the first day, so this lets you get around that.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Once the mod is installed, simply right click on any sprinkler, and it should water the area around it. You can right click from anywhere; you don't need to be right next to it for it to work. You can set the button used to activate the sprinklers to anything you'd like in config.json. Just make sure that the value in quotes is valid according to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]this webpage on key bindings[/url]!

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]
